dek: Cascade Space builds technology for beyond low Earth orbit. Its site is a Next.js static export with a block library: every block ships with a typed interface, a Storybook story and unit tests, and every word lives in content files, ready for a CMS.
short: A Next.js 14 static site for a space-technology company, assembled from a typed block library: every block has a TypeScript interface, a Storybook story and Vitest tests, and every word lives in content files ready for a CMS.

items.name: Vitest
items.note: with React Testing Library and coverage

highlights.title: Every block, three ways
highlights.text: Each block carries a data-module attribute, a TypeScript props interface, a Storybook story and unit tests: heroes, info-bubble hotspots, a beamforming visual, a reservation calculator, timelines and careers.

highlights.title: Content outside the code
highlights.text: Navigation, pages, blog posts, resources and legal copy live in content files, so a CMS can take them over without touching a component.
